purpose: use legitimate historical training information to reduce future absolute ash prediction error while preserving source, condition and label-availability differences
authorization: user authorized expanded training; laptop only; no activation, deployment, production model/config changes, or changes to first-round C7/core/shadow/frozen outputs

source_roles.inventory: 185 full-workbook + 21 recent-workbook + 77 database metadata rows = 283 raw source rows before deduplication/eligibility; counts are not a claim of 283 complete independent training cases

full_workbook.role: past training prior; never new independent test data for the frozen EXPERT8 baseline
full_workbook.archive_evidence: git blob JSON equals current frozen model JSON, including 177 training rows plus all 8 stored low-coal rows and the source-workbook hash; byte hashes differ because of serialization, not values
full_workbook.date_limitation: 16 individual dates were sequence-repaired; use the archived availability of the whole past pool, not repaired day values as verified sampling dates; all source months precede October
full_workbook.condition_limitation: 184/185 A-on, one A-off row with 473-on; exact current group 0,1,1,1,0,0 has zero rows; explicit domain adjustment does not prove transferable causal switch effects
full_workbook.low_coal: 8 rows omitted by the old importer are retained in E3/E5/E6/E7; E4 is the declared old-177 sensitivity only; do not turn a historical importer flag into confirmed physical stoppage or delete raw rows

recent_workbook.archive_evidence: tracked joined JSON contains the 21 values, five complete approximate feature vectors and all missing flags; git blob and working-tree JSON are semantically identical; the archive precedes all declared October replay targets
recent_workbook.role: only E7 may use complete, deduplicated, same-group approximate rows at the declared total weight; 16 missing-feature rows remain in inventory with no imputation
recent_workbook.availability: require an archived value-plus-feature availability record before a historical target; if only first captured now, eligible only for formal training after that capture; sample date, inferred date and filesystem mtime do not establish availability
recent_workbook.not_replay21: these source rows are distinct from the 21 October database replay targets

database.current_value_capture_authorized_ids: metric coarse_slime_ash, id<=202, id<>197; bounded one-time current 76-value snapshot
database.197: user-confirmed erroneous sample time; keep metadata, never read its value, exclude training/validation, no correction/deletion
database.191: value may be captured into raw inventory, but audited coal<=10/stopped remains ineligible for training or scoring
database.future_ids: ids>202 are not read and remain available for genuinely later evidence
database.historical_development: use the original frozen 68 values/features and initial-created-at proxy, never replace them with a subsequently edited current value
database.formal_training: use the latest actually captured eligible version at/after its own capture availability; preserve the frozen and new versions when a value changed; never backdate changes to original created_at
database.strict_vs_approximate: retain audited 90-second/30-second strict input criteria; non-level minute approximation remains a separate quality stratum and can enter only E7 at the fixed low total weight; no widening windows to improve coverage
database.current_version_comparison: at the captured snapshots all old68, prior6 and first182 values/metadata match; this does not prove an absence of intervening edits; preserve old snapshot roles regardless
database.label_review_reasons: 4 nearby-same-label records form pairs40/37 (12s, both11.88) and38/39 (5.537s, both11.88); 52/51 are28s apart with9.38/9.93;156 sample timestamp follows creation by22h27m. These are unresolved identity/time flags, not proven assay errors. All7 remain outside E7 and all training, not residual-based exclusions.

source_roles.deduplication: use canonical IDs and proven source/sample identity from the inventory; exact duplicated physical cases count once with all source references retained; near-time/value similarity alone does not justify merging; export raw/canonical/eligible/used counts separately

features.switches: normalize only declared 开=1,停/关=0 or exact numeric binary values; no silent defaults
features.level: fixed recorded sample-minus-90s input; workbook single values are already aligned per supplied provenance and are not shifted again; no physical-lag claim
features.no_extra_features: no trend/windows/polynomial/latent classes/raw-coal-ash feature, lag selection, interactions grid or learned feature search in this round
features.missing: do not fill missing factors with zero, averages, forward/future values or interpolation

training_and_fences.availability: select latest actually available version per assay before checking its group/time/quality; observed sample and availability must both be strictly before the target cutoff; exclude the target identity in every role; same-time label versions are unavailable
training_and_fences.primary_system_scope: shared legacy response may use legacy three/four-system data with all switch features explicit; current calibration requires the target's own >=3-system exact-group current labels; never lend those coefficients to a two-system branch
training_and_fences.fence_rule: linear Q1/Q3; [Q1-1.5*max(IQR,1pp),Q3+1.5*max(IQR,1pp)], inclusive; no residual-dependent deletions
training_and_fences.current_fence: once per target from all eligible available strict current labels in that exact group; shared by E0..E7 and all target normal-membership; approximate rows never redefine it
training_and_fences.legacy_fence: once from the pre-October full 185 pool separately by source and system count 3/4; identical legacy fence for E3 and E4 so the 177-row sensitivity changes membership only, not the fence; never apply a current-group ash bound to old sources
training_and_fences.approximate_fence: E7 accepts only complete same-target-group approximate cases whose label is within the shared current strict-derived fence; this does not change the target normal denominator; unresolved label-review/stopped rows remain excluded
training_and_fences.all_scores: retain and score all eligible target labels including training-fence outsiders; normal is a conditional report, not a known-at-prediction success filter
training_and_fences.gate_note: fitting minima are operational gates, not evidence that an 80 percent accuracy claim is statistically established

weight_policy.legacy_total: 0.25 * n_current_strict_normal; equal per eligible normal legacy row; E3 and E4 have exactly the same total legacy mass even though their counts differ
weight_policy.approximate_total: when eligible approximate rows exist, total is 0.25*n_current_strict_normal, divided equally across them; otherwise zero; never more than one quarter of current strict mass
weight_policy.source_domains: reference-coded current intercept plus only present nonreference legacy/recent-excel domain indicators; domain intercepts unpenalized; never full dummies plus an overall intercept
weight_policy.interpretation: weights and domain indicators are fixed modeling choices; A and source are nearly confounded, so regularized prediction coefficients are not independently identified causal A effects

E0.name: current-only median
E0.fit: same available normal current strict labels as the first-round C0

E1.name: current-only C5
E1.fit: Huber-ridge liquid-level linear response on same current strict normal labels

E2.name: current-only C7 control
E2.fit: replay the first-round C7 algorithm and legitimately issued C5 receipt residuals; never use a full-34 fitted artifact to predict its historical development rows
E2.formal_cold_start: no retrospective receipt construction; zero correction until sufficient actual legal receipts

E3.name: weighted legacy185+current shared eight-factor response
E3.fit: weighted Huber-ridge on all normal eligible legacy185 and current strict rows, with fixed source-domain intercepts

E4.name: legacy177 sensitivity
E4.fit: identical to E3 but old177 membership; same legacy total mass and same full185-derived legacy fences

E5.name: legacy response plus current intercept calibration
E5.legacy_fit: fixed Huber-ridge eight-factor response using only normal pre-October legacy185, each legacy row weight1, never current/tail/new labels
E5.current_calibration: median(current_y-unclipped_legacy_response(current_x)) on own-group strict normal available labels; add this offset to the same unclipped response then final clip

E6.name: legacy response plus current level/coal correction
E6.legacy_fit: exactly the same fixed legacy185 response as E5
E6.current_calibration: Huber fit of current_y-unclipped_legacy_response(current_x) to unpenalized intercept plus scaled level/coal correction; correction slopes receive ridge lambda1; only own-group available strict normal current labels

E7.name: weighted shared model plus bounded approximate augmentation
E7.fit: E3 plus eligible deduplicated complete same-group approximate DB/recent-workbook cases under the capped approximate total mass; source intercepts remain explicit

numerics.objective: sum_i w_i*rho_delta(y_i-X_i*beta) + lambda/2*sum(penalized response/correction slope_j squared); source/intercept columns unpenalized
numerics.solver: deterministic IRLS, Huber weights only on real data residuals; pure quadratic ridge not robust pseudo-observations; fixed iteration/convergence limits and gradient checks before fitting is accepted
numerics.failure: explicit unavailable state/reason; no undeclared rescue, hidden candidate-specific bounds or after-result parameter changes
numerics.output: reject nonfinite raw before clipping; report raw and final uniform [0,100] predictions and errors; selection uses final only; E2 preserves its declared C5-final-before-C7-bias semantics
numerics.support: report source weights/counts, raw/normal/excluded identities, feature ranges, extrapolation, design rank/conditioning and data variation; regularization does not prove factor identifiability

evaluation.main_availability: original frozen68 sample-time initial-created-at development proxy; not certified historical final-version availability
evaluation.selection: all E0..E7 on identical declared primary development IDs and shared current normal fence; full E0 coverage required; normal sample MAE, all sample MAE, normal date-balanced MAE, declared complexity, epsilon1e-9
evaluation.early_development_role: fixed additional already-viewed early forward-development description, not included in primary winner selection; report cold-start rejected cases and no future-label LOO/random split
evaluation.later_diagnostic_role: already-viewed October tail; no selection or tuning
evaluation.revealed_new_diagnostic_role: all six values are now exposed; use old68 at the original10/31 complete-snapshot availability plus legacy/recent source archive availability and current76 only at this round's actual capture. Thus none of the new6 values updates these earlier target predictions. E2 may use the original seed-only locked predictions under this same information budget. Strict and approximate scores remain separate; no new independent holdout or prospective claim; no extra created-at proxy replay of the new6 is added
evaluation.descriptive_fit: full-source/current refit scores explicitly in-sample, separated from every chronological replay and unavailable case
evaluation.causal_invariant_scope: target exclusion and non-influence invariants apply to chronological replay and future prediction; descriptive in-sample refit intentionally includes its training targets and is never presented as validation
evaluation.metrics: normal/all counts, MAE, raw MAE, date-balanced MAE, +/-1 and +/-2 counts, bias, median/p90/max absolute error, Wilson95, per-date/per-group/source coverage and paired differences; no percentage without denominator
evaluation.uncertainty: fixed-seed20261102 date-block paired bootstrap10000 draws for selected-minus-E0/E1/E2/frozen-E8/last-assay, with explicit normal/all scope; historical/exposed intervals descriptive only
evaluation.stopping: run the fixed eight candidates once; do not choose using tail/new-six/full-fit results; if old-data expansion does not beat current-only controls report that result rather than force expansion to win

two_system_branch.independence: each exact six-switch combination uses only that group's current available labels; no three/four-system parameters or fallback disguised as a two-system trained model
two_system_branch.T0: group-specific normal median; minimum3 normal labels; one-date support flagged as low support
two_system_branch.T1: group-specific Huber-ridge level response; minimum3 normal labels and2 sample dates, with level range/unique values/coefficient diagnostics
two_system_branch.selection: no winner selected from tiny historical groups; T0 retained only as provisional group reference, T1 diagnostic only; no80 percent claim
two_system_branch.chronology: true forward availability may yield zero eligible predictions; report zero coverage and reasons without lowering gates, random splits or LOO using future labels

required_invariants: first-round C7/core/shadow/protocol/artifacts and predictions remain unchanged
current target value or future current revision cannot influence its own earlier state/prediction
all candidates share current strict training/fence and the target normal denominator
E3/E4 total legacy mass is identical and equals0.25 current strict mass; E7 approximate mass never exceeds0.25 current strict mass
legacy8 response includes only pre-October pool and is identical for E5/E6 across target cutoffs
E2 historical control is chronological replay, never full-data artifact leakage
no missing factors filled; no approximate target promoted to strict; no stopped/unreviewed label silently admitted
all duplicate/source/label versions retain provenance and are counted once only when identity is proven
two-system branch never consumes a >=3-system model's parameters
nonfinite predictions cannot be rescued by clipping; raw/final metrics are distinct when clipping occurs
outputs: locked protocol/hash and immutable input/source manifests; source-role/dedup/eligibility/used counts; all model states/weights/fences/coefficients/IDs/versions; every prediction/rejection; separate early/main-development/tail/new-six diagnostic/in-sample/two-system results; selected reusable expanded candidate and all fixed candidate states; scientific limitations; meaningful causal/numerical tests; report; no activation/deployment
